purpose: Bounded SECURITY DEFINER capability that atomically revises one self-owned Activity, Event or Occurrence Schedule from an exact expected placement MaterialStateRef into an activated Schedule form while preserving monotonic history and immutable replay semantics.

routine.return_type: TABLE(schedule_ref uuid, previous_material_state_ref uuid, material_state_ref uuid, created_at timestamp with time zone, replayed boolean)

state_history.material_state_behavior: Creates one new immutable schedule.placement MaterialState per accepted non-replay revision, in the requested activated form.
state_history.current_binding: Locks the Schedule, requires the exact expected MaterialStateRef, closes the prior open history episode, moves explicit currentness and opens a new episode.
state_history.chronology: Prior and replacement current-history episodes meet at one authoritative recorded_at instant.
state_history.immutability_policy: Stale expected state conflicts before replacement; same operation and same intent replay without rewriting history.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: Migration-only capability removal; downgrade fails closed when revision history depends on it.

obligations: function owner is dante_owner and SECURITY DEFINER is enabled
runtime EXECUTE is granted while PUBLIC and dante_migrator EXECUTE are denied
typed self-scope accepts only Activity, Event or Occurrence Schedule owners authorized for the self Person
stale exact expected state conflicts before new MaterialState creation
revision preserves or explicitly changes form only according to submitted canonical placement
old history, new state, current binding, new history and receipt commit atomically
same operation and same intent replay without last-write-wins
Activity, Event and Occurrence continue to share one Schedule current/history capability
